scope: Bounded local read-only audit of the actual frozen v4 trainer replacement/adjustment and the isolated four-pass gradient observation seams. No SSH, model execution, production edit, deployment or commit.
status: The alleged outer32->repeat256/union64 geometry mismatch is excluded by the actual trainer source; numerical minibatch/gradient completion is not claimed by this source audit.

adjust_batch_pinned_recipe_source.scope: Local pinned VERL-agent 20bd331 owner source, not a newly measured remote installed-utils hash.

geometry.diagnostic_collect: Original official collector receives the first 8 original DataProto prompt rows; native env.rollout.n=8 produces the intended 64 actual trajectories. This is a bounded diagnostic subset, not a change to formal task budget.

replacement.conclusion: Original outer32-prompt batch is discarded. Returned64 trajectory carrier becomes batch directly. No repeat256/union64 operation executes.

adjust_batch.conclusion: On this text-only64-row native result, the existing owner returns the same DataProto; no delete/copy adjustment is required.

response_mask.conclusion: Actual frozen trainer prefers the original generation loss mask. It does not switch entropy/response metrics to an observation-inclusive attention tail.

balance.conclusion: Original official _balance_batch remains in place and can reorder actual64 rows. No diagnostic custom shuffler or repartitioner is installed.

credit_to_update.conclusion: Original reward/invalid penalty, old/ref logprob, DT scatter and compute_advantage run before the observed update boundary. The diagnostic boundary snapshots the native carrier rather than reconstructing token IDs.

planned_optimizer_geometry.source: Original actor lines384,399-403,473-488; effective per-rank config checked by the observer.

verified_dynamic_entry_seam.meaning: Real Ray CPU serialization inspected the original traced wrapper, inspect.unwrap body and its actual globals before the GPU diagnostic. Only the original body global RayPPOTrainer is temporarily bound; original bound Ray wrapper is still called for the actual run. Original worker module class is not replaced.

four_pass_boundary.full_native_carrier: Native global64 has original raw IDs, attention/position/loss masks, rewards, old/ref logprobs, advantages and uid/traj_uid. The driver adds only diagnostic_grpo_advantages on a separate official snapshot; the original DT advantages tensor is retained.

owner_source.signature: (token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor, response_mask: torch.Tensor, index: numpy.ndarray, traj_index: numpy.ndarray, epsilon: float = 1e-06, norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: str = True, compute_mean_std_cross_steps: bool = True)

grpo_owner_call.mask: Original loss_mask response tail for multi_turn; no text-based regrouping.

four_pass_boundary.loss_bodies: Each label calls the same original actor.update_policy. Native PG/H/KL scalar forwards remain unchanged; small scalar backward hooks pass the selected upstream gradient and zero the others. The full original graphs still execute.
four_pass_boundary.gradient_boundary: Copy actual trainable gradients immediately before the original _optimizer_step. Original FSDP reduction and eight B4 accumulation have completed. Native clip/nonfinite handling still executes; only optimizer.step and the outer worker scheduler.step are temporarily no-op.
four_pass_boundary.optimizer_state: No optimizer or scheduler parameter update by diagnostic design; checkpoint25 optimizer state is loaded by the original worker and is not advanced.
four_pass_boundary.restoration: Original actor.update_policy and scheduler are restored by context managers. Observer saves/restores original gradient objects/values, model training flags, gradient_accumulation and Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG; each fresh pass starts from the same saved RNG state.
four_pass_boundary.statistics: FP64 norm/dot arithmetic on native stored gradient values, not FP64 differentiation. Sharded DTensor scalar statistics are SUM-reduced on their original mesh; replicate/plain contributions remain local. No gradient full-gather/reducer replacement.
four_pass_boundary.measurement_scope: Pre-clip native complete optimizer-minibatch gradients. It is not the AdamW parameter update or a replay of historical steps35-40.

limitations: Source geometry and dynamic entry binding are verified; this audit does not claim the native64 completion, masks/scatter numerical replay or gradient results have returned.

Fresh checkpoint25 sampling is a bounded8-prompt subset. Official native n8 groups and horizon/config are retained, but the normal32-prompt/256-trajectory four-minibatch training iteration is not measured here.

Balancing only64 instead of256 changes microbatch composition. Native token-mean aggregation is per B4 microbatch then scaled1/8, not a single global64 token-count denominator, so this cannot replay historical full256 gradients.

Current diagnostic uses the accepted truncated-terminal-reward/mapping repair. That differs from the old deployed reward-loss bug and cannot by itself prove that bug explains the full historical degradation.

Component backward passes retain unselected graphs with zero incoming gradients; nonfinite intermediates may still propagate. A nonfinite result cannot automatically be attributed only to the selected label.
Separate BF16 component backwards need not sum bitwise to a single native combined loss backward. No combined-loss gradient reference or parameter-update comparison is claimed.
Norms/inner products can measure task vs H/KL direction and size on these samples; they do not alone establish optimizer dominance, causality of task degradation, or recovery.
G=0 gives zero DT PG for that sample while original H/KL remain masked generated-token terms. This is the accepted construction, not proof that regularization caused collapse.
No FA/FLA/vLLM official numerical tolerance, new fatal gate, correction, or production method change is introduced or claimed by this audit.
